reason: Hypothesis B proposes a physically sound, alloy-level intervention (Ag addition) that forms a self-healing oxide nanocomposite during sliding, directly addressing the need for reduced friction and wear across a wide temperature range. It is specific, testable, and extends the reactive wear protection concept from PMC8448869 to a new HEA context, whereas Hypothesis A relies on an external spray coating and trace organic vapors, which is less robust for bulk components and less clearly extends beyond the cited 2D nanoflake work.
